Rs. 10,216 crores, 21% year-over-year growth; no significant previous quarter dues accumulated
Rs. 6,432 crores net surplus, exceeding entire last fiscal year generation
Achieved zero gross debt in development business ahead of estimated timelines

themes: Strong cash generation and zero gross debt achievement; cash unlocking from FY27
Collection efficiency and quality of sales proving market resilience and demand strength
Margin and execution prioritized over volume; selective project launches only
Commercial rental business momentum with rising occupancy and rent commencement
Premium product positioning with brand strength attracting NRI and Rest of India buyers
Regulatory compliance and construction execution capability enhancements underway
risks: GRAP pollution control measures cause seasonal Q3 delays of 30-45 days annually in construction
Supply of Grade A contractors is constraint; management adding new contractors to pipeline
Large portion of cash trapped in RERA with meaningful unlocking only from FY27-28
Regulatory approvals required for multiple launches causing execution timing uncertainties
analyst_pushback: Puneet Gulati: Questioned if record collections Rs. 5,100 cr sustainable quarterly or accumulated prior quarters. Response: Look at annual basis, construction-linked, 10-15% YoY sustainable
Pritesh Sheth: Pressed on Dahlias monetization timeline vs initial 4-year target. Response: Doubled targets in 1 year due to strong pricing; dynamic pricing policy, timing varies
Abhinav Sinha: Challenged Gurgaon market strength vs peer slowdown commentary. Response: Strong collections prove market health; 25% NRI, 15% Rest of India sales showing depth
Kunal Lakhan: Pushed on new markets beyond Gurgaon and Westpark expansion. Response: No new markets mid-term except Delhi; Noida parcel under litigation remains interesting
tone_evidence: Defended market strength despite skepticism; committed to guidance despite low Q3 pre-sales; emphasized execution capability and margin discipline over volume.
